setup_man_role: setup the Sphinx man role extension that registers the man role and man_url_regex config value
create_man_link_node: create a docutils reference node that links to a man page URL using the name and section number
parse_man_role_text: parse ReStructuredText man role input matching the name(section) pattern and return a link node
customize_man_url_regex: customize the man page URL template using the man_url_regex config value with num and topic placeholders
review_man_role: review the man_role function that parses man page references in Sphinx documentation and generates clickable links
